Method of Attack: Ransomware distributed via Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) affiliate program allowing anyone to become a distributor for free; weaponized ransomware binary embedded into files such as EXEs, Office, PDF, or other documents sent via spam email or malvertising campaigns; victims pay ransom on payment portal with Bitcoin; affiliates receive 70% of ransom payments
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by ransomware stubs embedded in various file types
Indicators of Compromise: Ransomware distribution via RaaS portals on Dark Web
